2608.11167.title: MultiModal Code-Switching: Interleaving Visual Objects into Language for Explicit Object-Level Alignment
2608.11167.paper_summary: Existing Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) predominantly rely on image-text pairs for modality alignment pretraining, mapping global image representations to long textual descriptions. However, this image-level alignment suffers from referential ambiguity: models struggle to infer the correspondences between multiple visual objects and textual entities from the global representation, leading to data inefficiency and suboptimal semantic grounding. To address this, we propose MultiModal Code-Switching (MMCS), a novel pretraining paradigm that provides explicit object-level supervision. Inspired by the linguistic phenomenon of code-switching, MMCS interleaves vision and language by replacing textual entities with their corresponding visual objects, enforcing local vision-language grounding. We further develop a scalable data synthesis pipeline to generate a pretraining dataset of 773K samples with accurate object-entity correspondences. Experiments show that MMCS is highly data-efficient: with only 50K samples, it matches or surpasses models trained on 600K image-text pairs. Furthermore, MMCS consistently improves visual grounding and perception capabilities across varying model scales.
2608.11167.paper_summary_zh: 現有的多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）主要依賴圖像-文本對進行模態對齊的預訓練，將全局圖像表示映射到長文本描述中。<lb/>然而，這種圖像級對齊存在參照模糊性：模型在從全局表示中推斷多個視覺物體和文本實體之間的對應關係時面臨困難，導致數據效率低下和語義基礎不佳。<lb/>為了解決這個問題，我們提出了多模態代碼切換（MMCS），這是一種提供明確物體級監督的新型預訓練範式。<lb/>受到代碼切換語言現象的啟發，MMCS通過用其對應的視覺物體替換文本實體來交錯視覺和語言，強化局部視覺-語言對齊。<lb/>我們進一步開發了一個可擴展的數據合成管道，以生成773K樣本的預訓練數據集，並確保準確的物體-實體對應關係。<lb/>實驗表明，MMCS具有高度的數據效率：僅用50K樣本，它的性能與在600K圖像-文本對上訓練的模型相當或更佳。<lb/>此外，MMCS在不同模型規模下持續改善視覺對齊和感知能力。
